figures.caption: Figure 1. Cross-sectional SEM images of interlayers after charging under a–c) 1 and d–f) 5 MPa with current density of 0.5 mA cm−2 to a capacity of 2 mAh cm−2: (a,b) carbon, (b,e) Ag–C 200nm, and (c,f) Ag–C 50nm interlayer, respectively. All the scale bar is 10 μm.

Figure 2. Cross-sectional cryo FIB-SEM images of a) carbon, b) Ag–C 200 nm and c) Ag–C 50 nm interlayer after charging to a capacity of 1 mAh cm−2. Corresponding segmented pore images of d) carbon, e) Ag–C 200 nm and f) Ag–C 50nm interlayer. g) Pore size distribution within the interlayer after charging to a capacity of 1 mAh cm−2.

Figure 3. Modeling domains and stress distribution in a) Ag–C 200 nm and b) Ag–C 50 nm interlayer. c) creep Li metal ﬂux (represented as JLi0,creep∕K, where K is the nondimensional constant given in Equation 3) as a function of pore size for diﬀerent applied stresses. d) Schematic illustration of the mechanisms (Li creep and accumulation ﬂux) governing the deposition behavior. e) Variation of non-dimensional JLi0,creep∕KJLi+,reduction(𝜃) with pore size and applied current density.
Figure 4. X-ray diﬀraction (XRD) patterns of a)Ag–C 200nm and b)Ag–C 50nm interlayer before and after charging to a capacity of 1 mAh cm−2.

Figure 5. Cross-sectional SEM images of Li plated a,b) Ag–C 200 nm and c,d) Ag–C 50nm interlayer after charging with a current density of (a,c) 0.25 and (b,d) 0.1 mA cm−2 to a capacity of 2 mAh cm−2. All the scale bar is 10 μm. Schematic illustrations of Li electrodeposits morphology varying with JLi0,creep/JLi+,reduction.

Figure 6. Electrochemical performance for a–c) Ag–C 200 nm and d–f) Ag–C 50 nm interlayer with diﬀerent charging current density of (a,d) 0.5, (b,e) 0.25, and (c,f) 0.1 mA cm−2. Discharge current density is identical with 0.5 mA cm−2 for all test conditions. Cells are charged to a capacity of 2 mAh cm−2 and discharged to potential of 2 V. g,h) Variation in the coulombic eﬃciency during the repeated charging and discharging. i) Variation in interfacial resistance from ﬁtted EIS data after Li plating at current densities from 0.1 to 0.5 mA cm−2.

Figure 7. a) Schematic illustration of energy dispersive X-ray diﬀraction (EDXRD) for the Ag-C 50nm interlayer after 10 mAh cm−2 charging. Thickness of each layer is 20 μm. (b-d) EDXRD of b) pristine Ag–C 50 nm interlayer, Ag–C 50 nm interlayer after 10 mAh cm−2 charging under c) 1 and d) 5 MPa with a current density of 0.5 mA cm−2.
